data.exact_reserve_text: Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses (8,936)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Absence of major catastrophe activity in 2015 and 2016 contributed to a good level of releases from reserves established in earlier years.

named_events.loss_description: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria were the only significant losses materially impacting the account.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 8.936 million, primarily due to an over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses. This favorable development was attributed in part to the absence of major catastrophe activity in 2015 and 2016, leading to releases from reserves established in earlier years. The syndicate's business is 100% reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses
absence of major catastrophe activity in 2015 and 2016 and a good level of releases from reserves established in earlier years
data.data_quality_notes: The explicit prior year development figure from Note 8 (GBP 8.936m release) was used. A calculation based on the gross claims development triangle (Note 10) yielded a different figure (-3.400m release). The presence of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) activity for 2015 and prior years (Note 3) may distort the claims development triangle, making the explicit note a more reliable source for prior year development. Gross premium mix is based on the statement that all business written is reinsurance.
